column1: # Points of the exhaustive data test that must fail the frame checks: template<TAB>point.
# A point lists every parameter in order, lengths in mm. Anything not listed must pass.
# No PCIe point: card_length starts at the lane width's tab end, so a shorter card is out of
# range, not an invalid frame (#416 decision, issuecomment-7072198747).
# Custom rectangle: a corner radius over half a side crosses the outline over itself.
